༄༅/ /'jam dpal gsol 'debs padma dkar po'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal sras rgyal ba'i yab gcig

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'jam dpal gsol 'debs padma dkar po'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal sras rgyal ba'i yab gcig dmar ser li khri'i mdangs 'dzin pa// tshogs gnyis rkang 'thung rtser son mtshan gyi chu skyes rnam par bzhad// dpe byad yid 'phrog gsal ba'i ge sar phreng ba rab tu rgod// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so mkhyen brtse nus pas byin gyis rlobs// mthon mthing zur phud lnga pa'i utpal sngon po'i rtser 'dzing pa'i// rin chen khang bzang mdzes par rigs lnga'i sgyu 'phrul g.yo ba can// sna tshogs cod paṇa g.yo bas dbang po'i gzhu ris mdzes par 'gran// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so mkhyen brtse nus pas byin gyis rlobs// shes rab ral gris 'khri shing g.yo ba'i nyams can rtse brgya'i drwa ba 'gyed// 'dabs stong chu skyes stong phrag brgya pa'i raḥyig gnyis pa'i 'phur lding g.yo// mu men nor bu'i do shal 'od kyis nyi ma zla ba'i gzi byin 'gong*// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so mkhyen brtse nus pas byin gyis rlobs// zab rgyas sgra dbyangs rgyud mang ldan pas sa gsum yid rab 'phrog /gang gsung thos pa'i mod la blo yi 'dab brgya 'dzum zhing god// thos bsam nor bu'i pha phog sbyin mdzad yan lag drug cu'i nga ro can// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so mkhyen brtse nus pas byin gyis rlobs// mkhyen brtse 'od stong 'phro ba chags med chos nyid mkha' la gnas// gzungs spobs nor bu'i mdzod 'chang dran pa'i mod la snang ba ster// kun mkhyen ye shes 'bar ba'i the tshom rmongs pas tshang tshing bsregs// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so mkhyen brtse nus pas byin gyis rlobs// sa bcu'i rin chen rnam par sbyangs pa'i srad bus legs par brgyus// byang chub phyogs kyi puṇḍa ri ka'i chun 'phyangs 'dzin la bzod// gzhan yang stobs sogs yon tan chu gter pha mthar dpogs pa med// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so mkhyen brtse nus pas byin gyis rlobs// gang gis phrin las nam mkha'i rje sogs mthar gyis gtugs pa med// lhun grub mdzad bzang nor bu 'gran bzod de yi mtshon pa'ang min// rgyun mi chad par 'gro ba'i khams la rtag gzigs mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so mkhyen brtse nus pas byin gyis rlobs//

ces rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las la bsngags pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di nyid rdo rje'i mched dam pa lung rtogs 'od zer gyis yang yang bka' phebs spyi btsal bzhin shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang dpal bzang 'bod pas sbyar ba dge'o/// /
